{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Now, filter for completed orders with valid revenue (non-null)
completed_valid_revenue = sales_df[(sales_df['status'] == 'completed') & (sales_df['revenue'].notna())]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = completed_valid_revenue['revenue'].sum()

# Also, count total completed orders with valid revenue
num_completed_valid = len(completed_valid_revenue)

# Check how many rows were excluded due to invalid revenue
num_invalid_revenue = len(sales_df[sales_df['revenue'].isna()])

# Check if any of the invalid revenue rows are 'completed' — they are, but we exclude them
# Final output
total_revenue, num_completed_valid, num_invalid_revenue"}
